title: Lotus Sutra Intro
speaker: Shuko Edie Norton
summary: Shuko Edie Norton introduces the Lotus Sutra study group, which meets eight times into June, and gives a background lecture using Gene Reeves's translation. Shuko sketches the sutra's place in Mahayana development, Indian cosmology, and its claims: one vehicle, enlightenment open to all including women, and a Buddha present in every world. Shuko then reads the sutra's description of the Buddha's body, sixteen feet tall and shining purple gold, and the group wonders why it is so extravagant. Shuko suggests not getting hung up on it and assigns pages 82 and 85-102 on skillful means for next week.
